title: Every Space has one team room its members and collaborators chat in

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/BqySUVMoZYsPcR49SBRUqB)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-24: rooms support Space scope, but nothing creates a team room when a Space is made, so a Space team has nowhere shared to talk except DMs. Fix: ensureSpaceTeamRoom on Space create and backfill, membership following space_members and accepted collaborators.

ensureSpaceTeamRoom (lib/spaces/team-room.ts) makes one private room per Space (scope_id = space id) and keeps its members in step with the owner and active space_members on every team change; Spaces you run backfills older Spaces after render. No SQL.
